{{Top|leg}}
[[Margravine]] [[Quenelle]] of [[Nallastia]] owned a Nallastian '''rescue runner'''. She brought it to a deep-[[Realspace/Legends|space]] rendezvous point within the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]] to meet with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Rodd]] of [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]].

Both Rodd and Quenelle claimed salvage rights to what they professed to be the [[False Sun Runner|''Sun Runner'']], an ancient [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] that had, by all outward appearances, recently reappeared (the derelict was, in fact, a [[False Sun Runner|counterfeit ship]] fabricated by [[Groodo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] in a scheme to destroy the [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]] and surface factories). [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bultar Swan/Legends|Bultar Swan]] oversaw their salvage-rights negotiations in the [[Salon pod/Legends|salon pod]] of the [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|Republic cruiser]] ''[[Unitive]]''. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]]-[[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] team of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], on a [[Mission to Fondor (Separatist Crisis)|mission to Fondor]], were also in attendance.
